steps.note: the API built this case's state
Enable the multi-stage eRFX project capability required by the setup.
Ensure the Withdraw Project action is shown in the event menu.
Withdraw the complete project through the buyer-side project menu with a remark.
Assert Procol records the project as withdrawn.
Open the technical stage to verify its stage-level withdrawn state.
Verify the technical stage displays Withdrawn.
Open the pricing stage to verify its stage-level withdrawn state.
Verify the RFQ stage displays Withdrawn.
Move to the invited vendor portal to check the vendor-facing result.
Open the withdrawn project on the vendor's technical stage.
Verify the vendor sees the technical stage as withdrawn.
Open the withdrawn project on the vendor's pricing stage.
Verify the vendor sees the RFQ stage as withdrawn.
Return to the buyer console to inspect the event list.
Switch to History, the expected destination after withdrawal.
Verify the History view contains withdrawn events.
